other_conditions: The applicant must be an Ex‑serviceman or the widow of an Ex‑serviceman.
The applicant must be registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry.
The applicant must not be a member of the Ex‑Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS).
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹8,000 for the purchase of a hearing aid, credited to the beneficiary’s bank account.
documents_required: Prescribed application form (printed from the official website)
